source: Formulas.calcSkillMastery(actor, skill) and Formulas.calcEffectAbnormalTime(caster, target, skill)
note: kind 'mastery': result = the skill was mastered: only players, not static skills, SKILL_MASTERY stat 1 (STR bonus) or 4 (INT bonus), x SKILL_MASTERY_RATE; Rnd.get(100) < chance (class balance multiplier 1). 'draw' as in effect_success. kind 'abnormal_time': result = the effect time in seconds (int): skill time (-1 for passive / toggle), x2 when mastery succeeds (one draw for players that have the stat), debuffs scaled by resistances (DebuffDurationUsesResists). Servitor targets (halved herb buff time) are not covered. The abnormal_time cases use script variants 'm0' (draw 0.0: mastery succeeds when it can) and 'm1' (0.99). Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextGaussian is 2u-1 in the harness). Calls that draw nothing are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.
